title: Replay exact LP bounds, infeasibility witnesses and improving rays
body:
The new standalone checker validates certificates for max c*x subject to A*x<=b and x>=0. It reports exact primal/dual residuals and gaps, or verifies a Farkas infeasibility witness or a feasible improving ray. This lets candidate and resource optimizers use external solvers without trusting their numerical acceptance thresholds.

Seven tests pass normally and under -O on Python 3.12. Coverage includes 81 independently enumerated box optima, a nontrivial rational fee optimum, nonzero bound gaps, both Farkas sign conditions, a required feasible ray origin, strict rational boundaries, malformed dimensions, and isolated CLI byte binding.

The guide contains the short algebraic proofs, input contract, limits, and open source-containment obligation. This certifies only the declared continuous LP. It does not establish a physical family bound or new κ. Main and overlap refreshed; coordination: Discussion #5752.

Base: `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`. Verified head: `91b934dcc20971697613c86aa353598f8739c001`.
